feature: Eval quick wins: evaluator check, per-scenario timeout, dep install
problem: 52% eval score has false negatives from: (1) evaluator subagent can't launch in SDK so check always fails, (2) 3 scenarios timeout at 300s, (3) py_compile fails because deps aren't installed in sandbox
proposed_solution: Three targeted fixes to session_judge.py, session_runner.py, and sandbox.py
acceptance_criteria: Judge accepts role:evaluator breadcrumbs OR evaluation-type breadcrumbs as 'evaluator launched' evidence
session_runner reads timeout_s from scenario YAML, falls back to --timeout flag
sandbox.py runs pip install -q -r requirements.txt (if exists) before verify commands
All 23 scenarios still parse and run without errors
edge_cases: Scenario without timeout_s field: uses global --timeout default
Sandbox without requirements.txt: skip pip install gracefully
Breadcrumbs with evaluation type but no evaluator role: still counts as eval evidence
verification_method: python -m py_compile tests/eval/session_judge.py && python -m py_compile tests/eval/session_runner.py && python -m py_compile tests/eval/sandbox.py
